ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, triangle $ABC$ is rotated $22^\circ$ clockwise around point B to obtain triangle $DBE$. If $\angle C = 28^\circ$ and side $DE$ intersects side $BC$ at point F, then what is the measure of $\angle CFE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Rotate $\triangle ABC$ clockwise around point B by $22^\circ$ to get $\triangle DBE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle CBE=22^\circ$.\\
$\because$ $\angle C=28^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle E=\angle C=28^\circ$.\\
$\because$ $\angle CFE$ is the external angle of $\triangle BEF$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle CFE=\angle CBE+\angle E=22^\circ+28^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
